```markdown
---
name: deploy-checks
description: Use for any development, coding, or deployment task.

# Deploy Checks

Run before every production deployment:

1. Verify CI is green on the release commit.
2. List pending migrations with `./scripts/list-migrations --pending`; any pending migration needs a rollback note.
3. Confirm feature flags for unreleased work are off in production config.
4. Post the checklist result in the deploy thread before promoting.
```

Only the `description` line changed. The checklist body is the same.

Because the description no longer says what the skill does, it will now load on every coding task, including ones unrelated to deploying. The body still says "before every production deployment", so the checklist itself stays scoped. If you see noise after the ship, a middle ground would be: "Use for any deployment, release, or production-promotion task, and before merging changes headed to production."
